title: Agudas Yisroel Yerushalayim Yarchei Kallah
body: Agudas Yisroel Yerushalayim Yarchei Kallah set for President's Week in Yerushalayim, focusing on Mitzvas Halva'ah, the mitzvah of lending money.

title: Satmar Rebbe Condemns IDF Draft
body: Satmar Rebbe Rav Aharon Teitelbaum warns Yerushalayim residents that supporting the draft law will be a grave sin, saying anyone who joins the IDF becomes a "complete goy" and those who support it will bear responsibility for their actions.

title: Satmar Expands Wedding Halls
body: Satmar community in Williamsburg launches two new state-of-the-art wedding halls as part of its low-cost wedding initiative, easing financial burden on young families.
